Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Mode: vhs: tape artifacts only. crt: display effects only. both: tape then CRT.
Amount: Global strength of the effect. 0 = clean.
Wobble: Strength of slow horizontal tape wobble.
Chromableed: Width of the horizontal colour smear (chroma blur). 0 = none.
Chromashift: Horizontal shift of the chroma in pixels.
Tracking: Strength of the tracking-noise bands that roll through the picture.
Headswitch: Strength of the distortion band at the bottom of the frame (head switching).
Noise: Amount of tape noise and grain.
Softness: Horizontal luma softening of the tape. 0 = sharp.
Interlace: Strength of the interlace comb effect and dark alternate fields.
Curvature: Barrel curvature of the CRT screen. 0 = flat.
Scanlines: Darkness of the CRT scanlines. 0 = none.
Scanlinecount: Number of scanlines over the picture height.
Maskstrength: Strength of the RGB phosphor shadow mask. 0 = off.
Flicker: Strength of brightness flicker and the rolling hum bar.
